insights.summary: The agent successfully implemented advanced Triton kernel optimizations that align with high-performance GPU programming patterns. While it failed to verify the results due to environment limitations, the code changes themselves were correct and sophisticated.
strengths: High technical proficiency in Triton/CUDA kernel optimization.
weaknesses: Over-reliance on building the full repo in a restricted environment.
Did not optimize the secondary target file (moe_align_block_size.py) despite identifying candidates.
